title: Race Control
description: Bronze-layer event log. One row per race control message. ~50–200 rows per race (average ~100). Covers flags, incidents, safety car deployments, and procedure messages.
x-notes: session_time_s is null for all 2024 races due to FastF1 v3.8.3 API change. Use `Lap` instead; join to laps via lap number for precise timing. `message` text is unstructured   use regex or fuzzy matching. Race only; race control is never written for qualifying sessions.

x-phantom-columns.name: code
x-phantom-columns.reason: Never ingested; there is no `code` column in any partition.

Lap.description: Lap number when message triggered. Null for pre-race messages (parades, formation laps).

session_time_s.description: Time in seconds since session start. **Null for all 2024 races** due to FastF1 v3.8.3 DatetimeProperties API change. Use `Lap` for joins instead.

Flag.description: Flag colour: GREEN, YELLOW, DOUBLE YELLOW, RED, CLEAR, CHEQUERED, BLUE. Null for non-flag messages.

message.description: Human-readable message text. Unstructured   values include 'Safety car deployed', 'Debris on track', 'Lapped car released'. Use regex or fuzzy matching.
